changes.summary: Publish-state guard: block deletion of verified deliverable files.
changes.failure_evidence: Iteration-1 traces: agent deleted verified output files during post-success cleanup (cf. AHE Fig. 1 annotation 2).
changes.root_cause: The shell tool permits destructive operations on files the verifier has already accepted; nothing distinguishes deliverables from scratch files.

validation_criteria: tasks failing via post-success deletion flip to pass
no regression across the full suite (system-level validation, SPEC §7.2)

prediction.rationale: Guard only fires on paths the verifier has marked accepted.
